name: Strasbourg, Grande-Île and Neustadt
description: Strasbourg's historic heart sits on the Grande-Île, an oval island ringed by the Ill river and a canal, where the red Gothic cathedral towers over half-timbered lanes and the old tanners' quarter of Petite France. Beyond it lies the Neustadt, a grand district built under German rule from 1871 to 1918. It blends Parisian-style boulevards with German architecture.
